library(readxl)
library(dplyr)

options(scipen = 999)


## Import data

#| label: import-data

file_path <- paste0(
  "D:/PhD in Political Science-UTD/",
  "Fall 2026/",

data_raw <- read_excel(

cat("Original observations:", nrow(data_raw), "\n")

## Function that constructs an OCI window


#| label: oci-construction-function

construct_oci <- function(data, window_length) {

  organization_years <- data |>
    distinct(gname, iyear) |>
    arrange(gname, iyear)

  calculate_one_year <- function(group_name, focal_year) {

    historical_data <- data |>
      filter(
        gname == group_name,
        iyear >= focal_year - window_length,
        iyear <= focal_year - 1
      )

    prior_attacks <- nrow(historical_data)

    if (prior_attacks == 0) {
      return(
        data.frame(
          gname = group_name,
          iyear = focal_year,
          prior_attacks = NA_real_,
          tactical_diversity = NA_real_,
          geographic_spread = NA_real_,
          adjusted_success_rate = NA_real_
        )
      )
    }

    # Exclude GTD attack type 9, which is Unknown
    known_tactics <- historical_data |>
      filter(
        !is.na(attacktype1),
        attacktype1 != 9
      )

    if (nrow(known_tactics) == 0) {

      tactical_diversity <- NA_real_

    } else {

      tactic_counts <- table(
        known_tactics$attacktype1
      )

      tactic_proportions <-
        as.numeric(tactic_counts) /
        sum(tactic_counts)

      shannon_entropy <- -sum(
        tactic_proportions *
          log(tactic_proportions)
      )

      # Eight known GTD attack categories
      tactical_diversity <-
        shannon_entropy / log(8)
    }

    geographic_spread <- n_distinct(
      historical_data$district_spatial,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

    if (geographic_spread == 0) {
      geographic_spread <- NA_real_
    }

    number_successful <- sum(
      historical_data$success == 1,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

    adjusted_success_rate <-
      (number_successful + 1) /
      (prior_attacks + 2)

    data.frame(
      gname = group_name,
      iyear = focal_year,
      prior_attacks = prior_attacks,
      tactical_diversity = tactical_diversity,
      geographic_spread = geographic_spread,
      adjusted_success_rate =
        adjusted_success_rate
    )
  }

  component_rows <- vector(
    mode = "list",
    length = nrow(organization_years)
  )

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(organization_years))) {

    component_rows[[i]] <- calculate_one_year(
      group_name =
        organization_years$gname[i],

      focal_year =
        organization_years$iyear[i]
    )
  }

  components <- bind_rows(component_rows) |>
    filter(
      if_all(
        c(
          prior_attacks,
          tactical_diversity,
          geographic_spread,
          adjusted_success_rate
        ),
        ~ !is.na(.x)
      )
    ) |>
    mutate(
      ln_prior_attacks =
        log1p(prior_attacks),

      ln_geographic_spread =
        log1p(geographic_spread),

      z_prior_attacks =
        as.numeric(scale(ln_prior_attacks)),

      z_tactical_diversity =
        as.numeric(scale(tactical_diversity)),

      z_geographic_spread =
        as.numeric(scale(ln_geographic_spread)),

      z_success_rate =
        as.numeric(scale(adjusted_success_rate)),

      OCI = rowMeans(
        cbind(
          z_prior_attacks,
          z_tactical_diversity,
          z_geographic_spread,
          z_success_rate
        )
      ),

      window = window_length
    )

  return(components)
}


## Construct one-, three-, and five-year OCIs


#| label: construct-all-windows
#| cache: true

oci_output_directory <-
  "robustness_2_window_outputs"

if (!dir.exists(oci_output_directory)) {
  dir.create(oci_output_directory)
}

oci_data_file <- file.path(
  oci_output_directory,
  "alternative_window_oci_data.rds"
)

if (file.exists(oci_data_file)) {

  cat("Loading previously constructed OCI data.\n")

  all_oci_windows <- readRDS(
    oci_data_file
  )

} else {

  cat("Constructing one-year OCI.\n")
  oci_1year <- construct_oci(
    data_raw,
    window_length = 1
  )

  cat("Constructing three-year OCI.\n")
  oci_3year <- construct_oci(
    data_raw,
    window_length = 3
  )

  cat("Constructing five-year OCI.\n")
  oci_5year <- construct_oci(
    data_raw,
    window_length = 5
  )

  all_oci_windows <- list(
    one_year = oci_1year,
    three_year = oci_3year,
    five_year = oci_5year
  )

  saveRDS(
    all_oci_windows,
    oci_data_file
  )
}


## Validate the reconstructed three-year OCI


#| label: validate-three-year-oci

existing_oci <- data_raw |>
  distinct(
    gname,
    iyear,
    OCI
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(OCI))

validation_data <- all_oci_windows$three_year |>
  select(
    gname,
    iyear,
    reconstructed_OCI = OCI
  ) |>
  inner_join(
    existing_oci,
    by = c("gname", "iyear")
  )

validation_correlation <- cor(
  validation_data$reconstructed_OCI,
  validation_data$OCI,
  use = "complete.obs"
)

validation_summary <- data.frame(
  Statistic = c(
    "Matched organization-years",
    "Correlation with existing three-year OCI",
    "Mean absolute difference",
    "Maximum absolute difference"
  ),

  Value = c(
    nrow(validation_data),

    validation_correlation,

    mean(
      abs(
        validation_data$reconstructed_OCI -
          validation_data$OCI
      )
    ),

    max(
      abs(
        validation_data$reconstructed_OCI -
          validation_data$OCI
      )
    )
  )
)

kable(
  validation_summary,
  digits = 6,
  caption = "Validation of Reconstructed Three-Year OCI"
)

if (validation_correlation < 0.99) {
  warning(
    paste(
      "The reconstructed three-year OCI does not",
      "closely reproduce the existing OCI.",
      "Do not interpret the window models until",
      "the construction discrepancy is resolved."
    )
  )
}


## The correlation should be extremely close to 1. If it is below 0.99, stop and share the validation table before interpreting the models.

## Merge all OCI windows into the incident data


#| label: merge-oci-windows

oci_1year_merge <- all_oci_windows$one_year |>
  select(
    gname,
    iyear,
    OCI_1year = OCI
  )

oci_3year_merge <- all_oci_windows$three_year |>
  select(
    gname,
    iyear,
    OCI_3year = OCI
  )

oci_5year_merge <- all_oci_windows$five_year |>
  select(
    gname,
    iyear,
    OCI_5year = OCI
  )

window_data <- data_raw |>
  left_join(
    oci_1year_merge,
    by = c("gname", "iyear")
  ) |>
  left_join(
    oci_3year_merge,
    by = c("gname", "iyear")
  ) |>
  left_join(
    oci_5year_merge,
    by = c("gname", "iyear")
  )


## Create the common analytical sample


#| label: common-sample

common_sample <- window_data |>
  filter(
    ideology_category %in% c(
      "Maoist",
      "Separatist/Ethnonationalist",
      "Islamist"
    )
  ) |>
  transmute(
    hard_target =
      as.numeric(`Target Category`),

    organization =
      factor(gname),

    organization_year =
      interaction(
        gname,
        iyear,
        drop = TRUE
      ),

    year =
      factor(iyear),

    ideology = factor(
      ideology_category,
      levels = c(
        "Maoist",
        "Separatist/Ethnonationalist",
        "Islamist"
      )
    ),

    conflict_region = factor(
      conflict_region,
      levels = c(
        "Rest of India",
        "Kashmir",
        "Maoist-affected belt",
        "Northeast"
      )
    ),

    OCI_1year,
    OCI_3year,
    OCI_5year,

    ln_lagged_district_intensity =
      log1p(
        as.numeric(
          lagged_district_terrorism_intensity
        )
      )
  ) |>
  filter(
    if_all(
      everything(),
      ~ !is.na(.x)
    )
  )

common_sample_summary <- data.frame(
  Statistic = c(
    "Incidents",
    "Organizations",
    "Organization-years",
    "Hard targets",
    "Soft targets"
  ),

  Value = c(
    nrow(common_sample),
    n_distinct(common_sample$organization),
    n_distinct(common_sample$organization_year),
    sum(common_sample$hard_target == 1),
    sum(common_sample$hard_target == 0)
  )
)

kable(
  common_sample_summary,
  caption = "Common Sample Across All OCI Windows"
)


## Estimate the three common-sample models


#| label: window-model-function

estimate_window_model <- function(
  data,
  oci_variable,
  model_label
) {

  model_data <- data |>
    mutate(
      OCI_window =
        .data[[oci_variable]]
    )

  fitted_model <- glmer(
    hard_target ~
      ideology * OCI_window +
      conflict_region +
      ln_lagged_district_intensity +
      year +
      (1 | organization),

    data = model_data,

    family = binomial(
      link = "logit"
    ),

    # Fast initial estimation
    nAGQ = 0,

    control = glmerControl(
      optimizer = "bobyqa",

      optCtrl = list(
        maxfun = 100000
      ),

      calc.derivs = FALSE
    )
  )

  return(fitted_model)
}



#| label: estimate-window-models

window_variables <- c(
  "OCI_1year",
  "OCI_3year",
  "OCI_5year"
)

window_labels <- c(
  "One-year OCI",
  "Three-year OCI",
  "Five-year OCI"
)

window_models <- list()

for (i in seq_along(window_variables)) {

  safe_name <- paste0(
    "model_",
    gsub(
      "[^A-Za-z0-9]+",
      "_",
      tolower(window_labels[i])
    ),
    ".rds"
  )

  saved_model_path <- file.path(
    oci_output_directory,
    safe_name
  )

  if (file.exists(saved_model_path)) {

    cat(
      "Loading:",
      window_labels[i],
      "\n"
    )

    window_models[[window_labels[i]]] <-
      readRDS(saved_model_path)

  } else {

    cat(
      "Estimating:",
      window_labels[i],
      "\n"
    )

    window_models[[window_labels[i]]] <-
      estimate_window_model(
        data = common_sample,
        oci_variable = window_variables[i],
        model_label = window_labels[i]
      )

    saveRDS(
      window_models[[window_labels[i]]],
      saved_model_path
    )
  }
}


## Extract OCI coefficients and interactions


#| label: window-coefficients

extract_window_coefficients <- function(
  model,
  model_label
) {

  tidy(
    model,
    effects = "fixed",
    conf.int = TRUE,
    conf.method = "Wald"
  ) |>
    filter(
      term %in% c(
        "OCI_window",
        "ideologySeparatist/Ethnonationalist:OCI_window",
        "ideologyIslamist:OCI_window"
      )
    ) |>
    mutate(
      Model = model_label,

      Predictor = recode(
        term,

        "OCI_window" =
          "Maoist OCI slope",

        "ideologySeparatist/Ethnonationalist:OCI_window" =
          "Separatist × OCI",

        "ideologyIslamist:OCI_window" =
          "Islamist × OCI"
      )
    ) |>
    select(
      Model,
      Predictor,
      Coefficient = estimate,
      `Standard Error` = std.error,
      `95% CI Lower` = conf.low,
      `95% CI Upper` = conf.high,
      `p-value` = p.value
    )
}

window_coefficient_results <- bind_rows(
  lapply(
    names(window_models),
    function(model_name) {
      extract_window_coefficients(
        window_models[[model_name]],
        model_name
      )
    }
  )
)

kable(
  window_coefficient_results,
  digits = 3,
  caption = "OCI Coefficients Across Alternative Time Windows"
)


## Calculate ideology-specific slopes


#| label: window-slopes

extract_window_slopes <- function(
  model,
  model_label
) {

  slope_table <- as.data.frame(
    summary(
      emtrends(
        model,
        specs = ~ ideology,
        var = "OCI_window"
      ),
      infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)
    )
  )

  lower_column <- intersect(
    c("asymp.LCL", "lower.CL"),
    names(slope_table)
  )[1]

  upper_column <- intersect(
    c("asymp.UCL", "upper.CL"),
    names(slope_table)
  )[1]

  slope_table |>
    mutate(
      Model = model_label,
      CI_Lower = .data[[lower_column]],
      CI_Upper = .data[[upper_column]]
    ) |>
    transmute(
      Model,
      Ideology = ideology,
      `OCI Slope` = OCI_window.trend,
      `Standard Error` = SE,
      `95% CI Lower` = CI_Lower,
      `95% CI Upper` = CI_Upper,
      `p-value` = p.value
    )
}

window_slope_results <- bind_rows(
  lapply(
    names(window_models),
    function(model_name) {
      extract_window_slopes(
        window_models[[model_name]],
        model_name
      )
    }
  )
)

kable(
  window_slope_results,
  digits = 3,
  caption = "Ideology-Specific OCI Slopes Across Time Windows"
)

## Pairwise comparisons of slopes


#| label: window-pairwise-comparisons

extract_window_comparisons <- function(
  model,
  model_label
) {

  trends <- emtrends(
    model,
    specs = ~ ideology,
    var = "OCI_window"
  )

  comparison_table <- as.data.frame(
    summary(
      pairs(
        trends,
        adjust = "tukey"
      ),
      infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)
    )
  )

  lower_column <- intersect(
    c("asymp.LCL", "lower.CL"),
    names(comparison_table)
  )[1]

  upper_column <- intersect(
    c("asymp.UCL", "upper.CL"),
    names(comparison_table)
  )[1]

  comparison_table |>
    mutate(
      Model = model_label,
      CI_Lower = .data[[lower_column]],
      CI_Upper = .data[[upper_column]]
    ) |>
    transmute(
      Model,
      Comparison = contrast,
      `Difference in Slopes` = estimate,
      `Standard Error` = SE,
      `95% CI Lower` = CI_Lower,
      `95% CI Upper` = CI_Upper,
      `Adjusted p-value` = p.value
    )
}

window_pairwise_results <- bind_rows(
  lapply(
    names(window_models),
    function(model_name) {
      extract_window_comparisons(
        window_models[[model_name]],
        model_name
      )
    }
  )
)

kable(
  window_pairwise_results,
  digits = 3,
  caption = "Pairwise Comparisons of Ideology-Specific Slopes"
)
